bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Mixtape Strategy.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MIXTAPE STRATEGY.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Mixtape Strategy to preserve and revitalize the historic Black neighborhood of Camdentown. Money must be used to build a cultural hub at a property located at 44th Avenue North, Minneapolis, that has community gathering spaces and that focuses on fostering collaboration and innovation by empowering small, diverse businesses.
additions: $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Mixtape Strategy to preserve and revitalize the historic Black neighborhood of Camdentown. Money must be used to build a cultural hub at a property located at 44th Avenue North, Minneapolis, that has community gathering spaces and that focuses on fostering collaboration and innovation by empowering small, diverse businesses.
